source: The protagonist is stuck in the demon queen's army where power is everything, and he's just got some lame-ass support abilities. He's treated like shit. But then he gets his hands on the hypnotic staff, buffs it up, and becomes the ultimate hypnotist badass! First thing he does? Hypnotizes the demon queen's bitchy daughter Roa and takes her virginity. He also hypnotizes the demon queen Lavis, teaching them their damn place in the male-female hierarchy and how to be proper breeding bitches. Lavis has a hubby, and Roa has a lover, but they just can't resist the protagonist's hypnotic dick-worship teachings. Time to train these two sluts to be perfect breeding stock and take over the world with hypnosis and impregnation!
translation: 在力量至上的魔王軍裡，主角只有幾項弱得可憐的輔助能力，因此受盡霸凌。可當他得到催眠法杖，並運用輔助能力將其強化後，便一躍成為無人能敵的催眠高手！他做的第一件事，就是催眠魔王那傲慢的女兒羅亞，奪走她的貞操。隨後，他又催眠了魔王拉維絲，讓這對母女明白男女之間的支配關係，並將她們調教成專供繁殖的母狗。拉維絲有丈夫，羅亞也有戀人，但她們都無法抗拒主角透過催眠灌輸的陰莖崇拜。是時候將這兩個蕩婦訓練成完美的繁殖工具，憑藉催眠與播種征服世界了！
